# Poland, objects of Nov 20: prosecutors' count

| | Card 20261120-005 | Now |
|---|---|---|
| Objects | Kh-101, a second missile, and 'according to preliminary findings' parts of a jet-powered drone | **Three Kh-101 cruise missiles** (prosecutors, 11/22, per search summaries of Archynewsy and Euromaidan; prosecutor page not read) |
| Manufacture | not stated | Reported fourth quarter 2026, Dubna plant. One outlet's older Q2 2026 date refers to a July missile |
| Casualties | none | unchanged |

Also reported: Tusk 'intentional provocation' (Bloomberg, France 24); Poland asked for more NATO air defense; Rutte 'clearly dangerous', due in Warsaw 11/21. Direction: the event, date and 'no victims' HOLD; the drone identification FLIPS. Will's bookmark of 11/21 repeats the old count.
